card.name: Verbs of combining or balancing qualities
card.fires_on: Words like combine, balance, unify, both or compromising that come right before a list of two or more desired qualities. Mostly seen in general or science text about balancing strength, comfort or similar traits.

modes.label: Combine/balance verbs
modes.description: A verb meaning to merge or balance traits, just before the traits are named.
modes.example: enables biological materials to<< combine>> disparate properties such as strength, robustness

modes.label: Both / balance of
modes.description: The word both or the phrase balance of that leads into a pair of qualities.
modes.example: are capable of providing<< both>> properties - strength and robustness, very

modes.label: First quality in the pair
modes.description: The first quality right after a balancing verb.
modes.example: How protein materials balance<< strength>>, robustness and adaptability.

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words meaning 'both... and', 'balance' and 'take into account', so it pushes the model to continue with a pairing of two qualities.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about balancing or combining two good qualities, such as strength and flexibility.
